items.headline: EU ETS reform proposal raises questions for ETRM vendors
items.summary: The European Commission's 17 July proposal to revise the EU ETS toward its 2040 climate target could expand carbon-market scope into waste incineration, aviation and maritime, per CTRM Center commentary. Analysts say affected industries remain cautious as the plan still requires negotiation.

items.headline: Tether expands into commodity trade lending
items.summary: Stablecoin issuer Tether Holdings has moved into commodity trade finance, reportedly extending roughly $1.5 billion in credit to commodity traders with plans to scale further, per ICC Trade Finance reporting.

items.headline: Transpacific ocean rates ease from July peaks
items.summary: Transpacific ocean freight rates have softened from July's historic highs though costs stay elevated, with West Coast capacity improving while East Coast and Gulf Coast space remains tight, per J.M. Rodgers' August update. Panama Canal restrictions and South China weather disruptions continue affecting reliability.

items.headline: UK FCA advances EMIR clearing threshold changes
items.summary: The FCA has published amended UK EMIR technical standards, applicable from 26 January 2026, alongside updated validation rules and XML schemas to support implementation. A related consultation proposed raising the non-financial counterparty clearing threshold for commodities to €5 billion.
